breakdown.description: Both RAS and LES models are defined in `turbulenceProperties`. An OpenFOAM simulation cannot be both RAS and LES simultaneously; one must be chosen.
breakdown.reason: The agent failed to resolve the inconsistency. It repeated the user's error by including instructions for both RAS and LES models. The specification first states to configure `simulationType RAS`, but then also says to "Include LES section with LESModel Smagorinsky...". An OpenFOAM simulation cannot have both models defined in the `turbulenceProperties` file.
